facts.claim_en: Alaska's Office of Veterans Affairs says its services, and those of Veterans Service Officers, are provided free of charge.

facts.claim_en: VA says the services an accredited VSO representative provides on your VA benefit claim are always free.
facts.claim_es: El VA indica que los servicios de un representante acreditado de una organización de servicio para veteranos (VSO) en su reclamo de beneficios son siempre gratuitos.
facts.quote: The services that an accredited VSO representative provides on your VA benefit claim are always free.

facts.claim_en: An accredited VSO representative can help you gather evidence, file a claim, or request a decision review.
facts.claim_es: Un representante acreditado de una VSO puede ayudarle a reunir pruebas, presentar un reclamo o pedir una revisión de la decisión.
facts.quote: An accredited VSO representative can help you gather evidence, file a claim, or request a decision review.

facts.claim_en: VA advises making sure anyone helping with your claim is accredited with VA.
facts.claim_es: El VA aconseja verificar que cualquier persona que le ayude con su reclamo esté acreditada por el VA.
facts.quote: Before choosing someone to help you with your claim, make sure they’re accredited with VA.
